description.value: De Dutch is a BC-born chain of Dutch-inspired pancake restaurants founded in 1975, best known for its pannekoeken — large, thin 12-inch Dutch pancakes served sweet or savoury. With several locations across the Surrey area and the Lower Mainland, it operates as a casual sit-down brunch and lunch destination emphasising quality ingredients such as fresh-pressed juice, preservative-free bread, and Canadian-made Edam cheese. Cycling tourists may appreciate the generous portions and loyalty program for repeat visits along routes through the Fraser Valley.

No bike amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or takeout are explicitly mentioned on the website, so those fields default to null per the evidence rules.
